title: The 4 Best Leaf Blowers for Wet Leaves
h1: The 4 Best Leaf Blowers for Wet Leaves
metaDescription: Our 4 picks for leaf blowers for wet leaves, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at leaf blowers for wet leaves using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Toro PowerJet F700 Corded Electric Leaf Blower
products.blurb: Key specs: 725 CFM airflow, the highest CFM in this category's lineup, 140 MPH air speed, 12-amp motor, no battery to fade under load.
strengths: Highest CFM here, built to lift heavy, matted, wet leaves rather than just scatter dry ones
Consistent full power throughout use since it's corded, unlike a battery that fades as it drains
Toro markets the F700 specifically around heavy, wet leaf clearing capability
limitations: Cord management gets more difficult when working through soggy, muddy ground
No vacuum mode for bagging what gets piled
features: 725 CFM airflow, the highest CFM in this category's lineup
12-amp motor, no battery to fade under load

products.name: EGO Power+ LB6504 650 CFM Cordless Leaf Blower
products.blurb: Key specs: Up to 650 CFM turbo airflow, 56V ARC Lithium battery, 5.0Ah included, Up to 75 minutes runtime per charge.
strengths: 650 CFM turbo mode is close behind the corded Toro for wet-leaf clearing power
No cord to manage across wet or muddy ground
Long runtime means fewer interruptions mid-job on a heavy wet-leaf day
limitations: Still trails the F700's 725 CFM at maximum output
Turbo mode on wet, heavy debris drains the battery faster than dry conditions
features: Up to 75 minutes runtime per charge

products.name: Ryobi 40V HP Brushless Whisper Series 650 CFM Leaf Blower
products.blurb: Key specs: 650 CFM / 160 MPH turbo output, 40V HP Brushless motor, Cruise control trigger lock.
strengths: Matches the EGO's 650 CFM turbo output at a lower typical price
Cruise control lock helps on longer wet-leaf sessions that take more passes
Brushless motor holds output well under sustained heavy-debris load
limitations: Bare tool listings often exclude battery and charger
Slightly less consistent power delivery than the corded Toro under maximum sustained load

products.name: Greenworks 40V 185 MPH 340 CFM Cordless Blower/Vacuum
products.blurb: Key specs: 185 MPH / 340 CFM brushless motor, 2-in-1 blower and vacuum with bag, Includes 4.0Ah battery and charger.
strengths: Handles lightly damp leaves and recent light rain fine
Lowest price of the four for occasional wet-weather use
limitations: 340 CFM struggles with genuinely soaked, matted leaf piles
Not the right tool for heavy post-storm cleanup
Vacuum mode is not recommended for wet debris at all

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
We do not list prices or star ratings because they change. Check Amazon for current details.
